messages:
Sam (Finance): FYI: GCP settlement file shows two offset lines for reseller invoice RSR-24-1150 with net zero amount but different tax signs. Ledger can't map without subscription IDs.
Lina (Billing): Can you paste the settlement rows?
Sam (Finance): Snippet in ticket: 
line A: reseller_acme,transfer,RS-24-1150,qty:8,amount:800.00,tax:132.00
line B: reseller_acme,remove,RS-24-1150,qty:-8,amount:-800.00,tax:-132.00
Carlos (Partner Ops): That's the partner's seat migration flow. They used partner_ref RS-24-1150 instead of subscription_id. We need their migration manifest.
SettleBot: Imported GCP-SET-2024-04-30. Reconciler WARN: partner_ref-only offsets present.
Jules (Accounting): Policy: can't move revenue without documentation. Please request the manifest showing original and target subscription_ids and timestamps.
Lina (Billing): I'll put payout on hold for RSR-24-1150 and open a case with the reseller.
Carlos (Partner Ops): Drafting message: "We observed offsetting transfer/remove lines for RS-24-1150 in your GCP settlement. Please provide migration manifest (subscription_ids before/after) within 72 hours or we'll post a contra per finance policy."
Sam (Finance): Also ask them to confirm tax treatment so we don't double-post tax liability.
Carlos (Partner Ops): Sent. I'll update when they reply.
Jules (Accounting): Preparing temporary tax reserve JE for $132 pending confirmation.
Lina (Billing): Added reconciler rule: flag partner_ref-only offsets for manual review. Not auto-applied.
Sam (Finance): Thanks. Escalate to legal if no response in 72h.
Carlos (Partner Ops): Noted, reminder set.
